level_names.admin1: region (viloyat), Tashkent city or Republic of Karakalpakstan (OSM admin_level 4)

tips.plate/area-code/calling-code: plate region code (two digits at the left, flag and UZ at the right: 01 Tashkent … 95 Karakalpakstan) or landline area code (code 71 Tashkent, 66 Samarkand, 61 Nukus…, nine-digit national format or with +998) → `clues.py lookup plate|area-code <value> --country uz` + `board.py apply`
